plans.idea: Centred poster stack: a tall, full-width text box in the optical centre makes the headline wrap to four big lines (Sparkle / slowly. / Sip at / sunset.) with the small orange subhead right under it, and dark space above and below as even framing.

Top-anchored editorial: the headline starts high and fills the upper two-thirds at maximum size, read top to bottom like a story format, and the lower third stays open as calm sunset-dark space with a small sign-off area at the base.

Bottom-weighted horizon: a large empty dark sky on top, with the headline and subhead set heavily in the lower half like a sun going down, and a small minor slot capping the top edge so the empty top looks deliberate.
